meta.description: Android and iOS apps for a beauty competition for a client in Asia.

caseStudy.title: Bikini
caseStudy.lead: Android and iOS apps for a beauty competition for a client in Asia.

facts.label: Platform
facts.value: Two native apps: iOS and Android

brief.title: The brief
text: The organisers wanted apps for their competition on both major platforms, so I built two separate native apps with Firebase behind them.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the iOS app natively with UIKit.
Built the Android app natively in Java with XML views, including the animated splash where the logo opens up into the app.
Structured both apps with a clean architecture.
Used Firebase as the backend for both.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Two native competition apps, one per platform, on a shared Firebase backend.

cta.title: Have a project like this?
cta.text: I build and rescue native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps, and I'm happy to look at yours.
cta.label: Get in touch

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.text: Two native apps on one Firebase backend.
